_note: Fictional demo content for the demo front door on the Swiss server. No real person, no real address. audience: fof = friends of friends (every asker of this peer is an acquaintance), friends = friends and close friends only, me = only me. A line is shared ONLY when it carries a preset (a permission the owner set in advance: by, at, note); the asker sees that mark next to the line. Lines without a preset are held and never shared by this service; the owner's phone decides them live when it is bound.
